primary_metric: All-visited feasible nondominated archive HV; shared pooled per-case empirical normalization and reference (1.1,1.1,1.1).
statistics: Two-sided exact paired sign-flip of HV mean difference; Holm across all 5 contrasts and 4 cases, family size 20. Sign-exchangeability under the null is assumed.
selection_basis: LM range scaling improved 6/6 screening pairs; wake grouping improved 6/6 against random; DGEA no-writeback reduced duplicates but worsened HV in 6/6. Retain the adverse treatment explicitly. LM fill is a new prespecified mechanism intervention based on deterministic initial shrinkage, not a screened winner.
new_variant_scope: LM_fill_population preserves original nondominated/APD survivors, then fills to 100 from existing candidates by feasibility, nondomination rank and crowding. No new random immigrants, extra evaluations or phenotype deduplication. It is a proposed adaptation, not original LMOCSO.
controls: Same physical objectives, cost parameters, N, candidate pool and initial 100 layouts within each case/seed. V3 and screening evidence remain unchanged.
interpretation: Longer-budget independent-seed confirmation, including transfer to obs_01. Fixed N=400; not a turbine-count scaling study. Record negative and inconclusive results as well as improvements.
